proposition: The Second Aristotle paper calls Afżal al-Dīn b. Ḥabīb Allāh Turka (d. 1583) Ibn Turka's great-great-grandson; the dissertation says Ḥabīb Allāh was possibly the great-great-grandson and Afżal al-Dīn, Ḥabīb Allāh's son, therefore one generation further down.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, The Second Aristotle Turns Astro-Lettrist
